chunks: The edifice they have built will always fill their minds with perturbation (which will not cease) till their hearts are rent to pieces, for God is all-knowing and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'ribah' and 'qat' al-qulub' in the context of the hypocrites' hearts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the persistent internal dissonance of the hypocrites (munafiqun), whose self-constructed 'edifice' of doubt remains until death severs their hearts (qat' al-qulub). It underscores that God's omniscience encompasses this hidden spiritual reality, serving as a warning against the fragility of faith built on insincerity.
